Poblano Turkey White Bean Chili

A creamy, gently spicy white chili of pan-roasted turkey, roasted poblanos and cannellini beans, finished slow in the crock pot.

Makes about 10 cups

Cook mode
  1. Brown the turkeyStep 1 of 15

    Lay the turkey breasts skin side down in a frying pan.

  2. Brown the turkeyStep 2 of 15

    Top them with the garlic, serrano, Italian seasoning, garlic salt and butter.

  3. Brown the turkeyStep 3 of 15

    Cover and brown without turning until the edges just start to crisp.

  4. Brown the turkeyStep 4 of 15

    Flip and brown the second side the same way.

  5. Build the baseStep 5 of 15

    Add the bouillon cubes and half the water (2 cups).

  6. Build the baseStep 6 of 15

    Cover and stew until the turkey reaches 168°F.

  7. Build the baseStep 7 of 15

    Lift out the turkey to rest, and reduce the pan liquid until thick.

  8. Build the baseStep 8 of 15

    Dice the turkey, return it to the pan and toss to coat.

  9. Build the baseStep 9 of 15

    Toss in the flour, then stir in the remaining water until it thickens.

  10. Build the baseStep 10 of 15

    Add the poblanos and beans, and reduce until thick and gloopy.

  11. Finish in the crock potStep 11 of 15

    Move everything to a crock pot.

  12. Finish in the crock potStep 12 of 15

    Stir in the heavy cream, then the half and half, to loosen it.

  13. Finish in the crock potStep 13 of 15

    Add the black pepper and cumin.

  14. Finish in the crock potStep 14 of 15

    Simmer on high for 1 hour.

  15. Finish in the crock potStep 15 of 15

    Ladle into bowls and top with sour cream and cilantro.

  16. Chili’s ready. Ladle it up and top with sour cream and cilantro.
